game_concept: A arcade set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the tomb cartographer's backpack list as ghost knights drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the tomb cartographer's backpack list as ghost knights drop loot. Each round, a new glyph tablets challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 290 points of glyph tablets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pillar Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
